text: Yummy yummy yummy, best I've had in a long time, maybe ever... buffalo chicken deep dish pizza is a must

There were some good and some really bad about this place.   The air conditioning didn't work the first night so we sweat our butts off.   Then the hotel claimed to fix it and yes it was a little cooler but still was hot in the room.   The tub didn't drain so it backed up for every shower.  Toilets didn't flush properly.  There were some hair strands on one of the beds when we checked in.  Had to wait 30 plus minutes for an elevator on Sunday.  Not a big restaurant selection however Rosies was good and waitress was amazing.   Pool was nice.  The bar tender at Horse shoe bar was super rude and snippy.  Overall, we will be staying somewhere else.

I am basing my review more on covid safe, then the actual food. I have visited 3 Tampa restaurants since March. I generally at out about 2/3 times per week pre covid. Yeomans was a frequent spot.
I was pretty disappointed today. We sat outside in the bar area and fortunately they were not very busy. We were handed their standard menus, my husbands was actually a bit dirty and metal utensils wrapped in cloth napkins. I did observe from a distance masks worn incorrectly by the staff  although our waitress did approach our table with a correct mask.
Although the food was delicious as always, I will not be returning anytime soon.

Eto Pizdets poliniy. 

The service is absolute ZERO

The food is dogshit, 50 minute wait for 8 overcooked watered down potato vareniki. 
After we completed our dinner the waiter brought over a plate of potatoes. we sent it back.

Oh, and the waiter had the never to give himself and 18% tip.
A cute little hole in the wall but great food. Very fresh and inexpensive. Classic cha siu fan is very good!

I'm pretty satisfied with their protocol in making sure that the customers are social distancing. The ambience is really nice, our server was really nice, and kept checking on us (he's a Spanish speaking man which name starts with letter J). We went here during lunch time, and it wasn't as packed as I expected (which is good). Their deserts are really good, especially their cheesecakes! For their main food, i love their Hispanic and Asian section. The reason why I removed one star is because their steak (which i was told was medium rare) was RARE. It's so bloody, it's not even a medium rare. Their grilled chicken was also dry, but their fried chicken was really good (way better than KFC). Overall had a nice experience despite during pandemic!
One of my must go to places every time I'm in NOLA! The crab stuffed flounder is amazing, add some crawfish etouffee for a bonus touch. The seafood pizza is another top choice of mine.

This place has no way to manage the order flow or the work flow.  They continue to answer the phone and take orders when they got 15 clients in the store waiting.

They have no system to determine whose order is finished so your waiting for your order and it has been ready for 10 minutes.

Poor mgt.
The pizza was good but the sauce is sweeter than we like . Tomatoes are sweet enough. The dough is good , we got the pesto tomato pizza.. if you are from New York it does not measure up.

The owner of Foundry Bakery really takes care of his customers as well as the quality of foods! We made online order from out of state during thanksgiving week, the owner made a phone call to let us know that in order to taste the most freshness of the foods he gave us suggestions when's the best time to sent out the products which says a lots about the characteristic of their business. Needless to say that everyone enjoying very much pineapple shortcakes and taro globes ! Wishing them the best!

We waited an hour and a half to get undercooked calamari. The dough was still soggy on the inside. The service was awful! Waiter rarely checked in. The food was honestly pretty good- the grouper was okay- but the shrimp was fantastic.

Decided to try the drive-thru since my newborn was sleeping.. the service was quick, friendly and professional. There were 2 cars in front of me, but the line moved very quickly. I was offered the newest options on the menu, but didn't feel rushed or pushed. Greeted with a smile at the window and an overall great experience. I like the option of the drive thru and will be back.

2 1/2 stars 
Over rated!!! Please do not waste your precious $11.50. While visiting Philadelphia, one of the must dos was trying a philly cheese steak! We tried Geno's and Pats, which seem to be pretty popular, one in front of the other. Very visible signs.  In our opinion, Pats was much better than Geno's. We bought their most  popular cheesesteaks which is basically  flavorless meat and whiz and we also order cheesesteak with mushroom. 
As a family of 5, we all came to the consensus that it's overrated. On the other hand Geno's fries were pretty good! 
Happy with Wawas cheesesteak!!
Food is always good, had oxtail tail, jerk chicken , shrimps on different occasions and food is always finger licking.  You want good Caribbean food this is a good friendly place. Staff always nice
Not the best tbh but you know it be what it be. Also the fries kinda suck. There way to moist.

Was pleasantly surprised by this place on carrolton. My friend who is a regular here always gets the poke bowls and swears by them. They definitely look super appetizing! I tired the pork rice plate dish and was impressed by the portion size and the meat quality, although the meat was a bit over salted. Reasonably priced, and offers lots of options! The ambiance inside was comfortable and casual. Will probably come back and try one of those poke bowls.

Mr. Ed's is usually our first stop when we get into town.  One of our favorite places to eat in NOLA.  Great casual, laid back atmosphere with awesome food.  Everything we've had there has been great. Raw oysters are always great here.  For us, other must-try's are: chargrilled oysters, crawfish bread, crawfish etouffee, gumbo and jambalaya.   Everything we've tried here has been great - you really can't go wrong!  Plus, the staff is always  friendly and the service is great.

I picked this place for my birthday and I could not be more satisfied! I love everything about this place, the decors, the food, the environment and the servers. Everything was on point. We were a party of 2 and we ordered the ceviche, the pork belly and rice, and the whole fish and we were so full! Out of these dishes, the pork belly stood out the most to me! The meat melted in my mouth. It was a little too salty for my taste but it paired well with the white rice. The fish was the most well-seasoned. Ceviche was okay because I had better elsewhere. You only get fish in the ceviche so I guess that's the downside. I would prefer having shrimp or seafood mix. Overall, I'm happy with my experience and would come back for another special occasion.

One of my absolute favorite restaurants in SB. The food is always worth the wait, very yummy and good portion sizes. I like all of their locations, but the Montecito one is my personal favorite because of their cute patio seating
The people who work here are the rudest I've ever encountered. They constantly hang up on you and ignore you in person.

So good period. I managed to get reservations thru Resy at the sushi bar section a few days after it opened. Please get these seats if you can. I think it's a better experience. We were happy to sit right in front of the chef and have a few small conversations with him and the customers next to us. I really loved the vibe of the restaurant, as it reminded me of Kyoto. The customer service was exceptional and the food was amazing. I've had omakase in Japan recently and I loved this restaurant a lot more. I did feel full after the meal but I could see how some people would leave a little hungry. I wish I could compare to royal izakaya but I haven't been there yet. However, I can definitely see this place being one of the top sushi restaurants in philly.

First off, I would like to mention that this review is a review of this location, and not Chick-fil-a as a whole. I went in to quickly grab a sandwich and fries before heading back to work. I sat in line for a short time, ordered, then waited for my food. I was forced to wait 15 minutes for my food! People who ordered after me in line were getting their food way before me, with many of their orders having the same items as my order, and sometimes being the same as mine! Why would they get their food before me... as if my order was lost in time and space! It's a shame really, I know Chick-fil-a is better than this.

Well at this point it's my fault they messed up my order. I feel stupid for ever thinking they would get it right and still order from them!This is a corporate business. You need to get your shit together and employ people that pay attention to details. I understand it was crazy busy and you guys were so overwhelmed. I work in mental health and am very overwhelmed at times. However, I am a gluten free diabetic that needs to count on their food being gluten free, and as a type 1 diabetic you pray your food isn't fucked up when you've already taken your insulin. Having to send it back means you know have little time to get carbs on board before your blood sugar plummets and you die. When I got home I should have checked the bag first (because I should really know better by now) and took my insulin after. My burger was put on a regular bun, which unfortunately means I can't even eat the eat the burger because it has been cross contaminated. (Being gf sucks) So now insulin is on board and I'm now scrambling to put together a dinner of cheese and crackers, not the burger I ordered. I called the restaurant to let them know and was talking to the gentleman that originally had taken my order when I was hung up on. I then called back and was given to the manager Jesse, he said that he has been there for the last 4 weeks. This means that the last manager that assured me things were going to change has left. He offered to do something, I asked if he would comp a burger for lunch sometim

Tried Divvy for the 1st time Saturday and was blown away. Our server was so sweet and attentive despite the fact that they were SLAMMED. And our food was amazing. 
We opted for the vegan/gluten free tour board, brisket tacos (for my husband)and and the lamb for myself. So so good. The tour board was great because we got to sample things we were hesitant about without getting, or wasting, a full order (squash tots sound weird but do it!! Delicious). My lamb was so juicy and seasoned to absolute perfection. My husband couldn't stop raving about his tacos. We left satisfied and planning our next visit.

Beef Pho W/ Meatball, Tripe and Tendon ($11): really clean broth, and I loved that it was kind of tomato-ish based as well (just slightly). Tripe was clearly braised and tender, but the pork meatball was a little weird tasting (maybe not the freshest ground pork?)

Burmese Pork Curry Po-Mi: soooo salty but damnnn these flavors! The pork curry is absolutely oily and delicious. It soaked into the bread and down my fingers with a little spiciness that was perfect. If they made this less saltier, I would definitely order again and again. Crispy and airy bread too!

Lemongrass Chicken Vermicelli: too much fish-sauce for this one, to the point it was a little sour for me to keep eating. All I could taste was that flavor, and the lemongrass chicken was very subtle to bland for me in comparison. Chicken not charred at all. "Healthy" but not that delicious

Spicy Cucumbers ($4): it's okay, it's just cucumbers. Hard to mess that up

Very dirty place, ALL the workers are either on drugs or just plain ignorant. Very expensive food for a sub par product. The sides are old and appear to be some sort of reused leftovers...From a place that had great potential this place is mismanaged from the top to the bottom. Should I Post Pictures? One simply needs to look around to see this. Furthermore just saying something isn't TRUE doesn't make that grime, subpar sides and bad service go away...

Love the atmosphere of this little room ... so charming!  Just like being in Europe, so relax and enjoy the experience.  And the FOOD!  Oh yum!  Husband had been wanting a po'boy and had their excellent breakfast version.  But I can't resist crepes, and they have a wonderful selection. The Bacon/Scallion/Brie/Apricot was perfect:  lots of crumbled bacon in a fantastic combination of savory/creamy/sweet.  If you don't have time to both a savory and a sweet crepe, this is a great compromise.  So large that I was able to take some with me for a snack on the flight home that afternoon.  If I'd discovered Cafe Conti on our first day, I would have eaten here every day!

Authentic old-school bagels & plenty of spreads, breakfast & traditional fillings & some of the best coffee anywhere.
Luke is awesome. What a positive attitude & a smart guy whose always on point along with the rest of the staff

I ordered a dish called teriyaki delight. It was described as being chicken shrimp beef with vegetables. I received the order, it was nothing but meat and onions. I called the restaurant to complain, the woman told me I was wrong, when I was looking at the dish description right in front of my face. This restaurant used to be good. But obviously that is not the case anymore. Avoid!
I went here to eat recently and the food was so good! My waitress Tiffany was also very friendly and attentive. Great food and service!
I took the entire family here for lunch. The burgers were really great. The wife and kids absolutely loved everything that we had.

It was terrible. Total waste of money. We came for the lunch buffet. Rice was hard and was like chewing rocks. Naan was dry and chewy. The Paneer tasted like soggy and musty. It was a horrible experience. Also, upon questioning is the meat was possibly halal, we got 3 very different shady responses. I wouldn't trust this place. Again, total waste of money.

This is my favorite ice cream shop and not because it is walking distance from my house. I love the eclectic atmosphere of old school games, fun and creative pictures and amazing staff. They have a unique ice cream selection with even better names. Yet the topping on the ice cream name is the sweet drawings that go along with them. My current favorite is Munchie Madness and contains everything! They have something for everyone, dairy free, soy, and gluten free. Their scoops are huge and you cannot get three scoops in a waffle cone. They offer a variety of cone and cups sizes. I always ask for 1 scoop. 1/2 of munchie madness and 1/2 yippee skippee. They also offer bubble tea, shakes, banana splits and so much more. Wyliepalooza is definitely an Eastside staple.

I've tried 3-4 Thai restaurants in Reno/Sparks, and I eventually decided to always come to this one. The serving sizes are huge, and the price is very competitive. The food is delicious and much better than Thai Corner Cafe.
Fresh and healthy ingredients. I will definitely come back and try more food they have!

We just tried The Deck, which is new to New Hope.
We had a great Server from Peoria Illinois.... She suggested we get the Pulled Chicken Tacos & they were Delicious !

She made the Bloody which was fabulous !

The canned Cape May IPA was good,  but not cold enough.....

Loved the River View.
Will go back again, when in town.
Debra & Michael

Being Greek, I always have high hopes for Greek restaurants and was excited to try this place. My first time going the food was average but I decided to go back with some family tonight and was thoroughly disappointed. We ordered many appetizers, which of course included saganaki, which was one of the only good dishes of the night. When our entrees finally came they were not warm. On top of that, they ran out of vegetables so we were all given rice as a side without an option, and the rice was not cooked enough. However, the worst part of it all was the terrible service we received. To begin with, when the waitress brought over our wine she told us how horrible she thought it was and questioned "how the hell do you people drink this". Throughout the night she only asked the men at the table if they needed anything, and ignored when we (the women) would ask for anything. It wasn't until my dad handed her his card with our very Greek last name that she realized he was Greek and started to treat him with respect, after saying "you don't look Greek". When leaving she asked if we were all Greek and we replied saying only my dad and I are, she then rolled her eyes at my mother and said "oh you married in". Very disappointing, won't be returning.

Muriel's is one of my must visit places when I'm in NOLA. It's so charming. The staff are friendly. I love the decor and the lavish lounge upstairs. If you're lucky you may even get to sit at the private table that is reserved for the ghost of the original owner. 
The food here is very good. The bread is yummy and they make a good gumbo and tasty shrimp n grits.
They have a nice cocktail menu and my absolute favorite is the Honey Child. Made with Cathead honeysuckle vodka and fresh blackberries. It's delicious! Nicole is an excellent bartender. I hope to see her on my next visit.
Holly served us and was amazing. Will definitely be back to enjoy the amazing food and drinks.

Placed our first order from this location. Our food was terrible! The fried mushrooms were gross! The potato wedges with bacon and cheese was a piled up sloppy mess! The pizza was gross and the cheese cake had a artificial taste to it! Would bot recommend them at all!
Great Vacation Vibes! Music, food and ambiance is excellent!! Also, great customer service with a palm tree view! I truly enjoyed this place and highly recommend! Will definitely be coming back!

Absolutely fantastic restaurant. The food is consistently delicious and always well presented. The portions are very well balanced and generous for the price. The staff are always very kind and considerate. They never let you have an empty cup of coffee! Wet Hen is always my first recommendation for people that are looking for a relaxing, tasty, and quality breakfast.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, Wet Hen made a great effort to ensure that every table was properly spaced apart and sanitized after each party was finished eating which is very appreciated.
Very friendly staff all from the same region of Thailand or Suriname. Food was delicious and very family friendly prices.
The wings here are  Very filthy delicious!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  Even though it is packed every Super Bowl we always order Keep up the good work.

Wow! I can't believe I've never tried REAL ramen! 

Nothing says "comfort food" like ramen. Hot, full of flavor and mouth watering spices. Yum! 

I'm a huge fan of looking at reviews before I try a new restaurant. I'm so glad I did. I read one review that said "get the Akamaru, it's the best!" 

I've never been to a ramen restaurant so I didn't know what to expect. I asked my waiter which ramen he liked best and he recommended the oxtail because he really likes beef... but I decided to try the Akamaru like the review suggested. 

The waiter recommended to get it "mild", suggesting I add more spice if needed (pointing to the glass jar full of red spice paste on the table). 
---I ended up adding a healthy spoonful of the paste to my broth and I could have added an addition spoonful if I wanted to. It was pretty mild. 

For my appetizer I got an order of 4 Gyoza (aka "potstickers") which are wontons (fried on one side) with pork, cabbage, and spices inside). It comes with some sauce that is indescribable...  and addicting. Salty. I inhaled them. 

The Akamaru contains sliced pork belly (full of smokey flavor and fat), dark brown mushroom strips (which I forget the name of), bamboo, 2 halves of a soft boiled egg, chives, of course...ramen, the same red spice paste that you will see on the table (which is pretty mild), and some delicious "mayo" broth that separates into white/yellow broths before you stir it. 

I left the restaurant with an empty bowl and a full belly.

We were so disappointed with the food here. The octopus was mostly chewy and the pickled veggies were a bit too bitter. We had the tortelli which supposedly was filled with venison. First of we could not taste any venison whatsoever, in fact all we could taste was what we think was a bland potato filling, and the wild boar ragú was completely under seasoned. The same applies to the bucatini all'Amatriciana, totally under salted tomato sauce and the pasta was over cooked, plus there was barely any guanciale in the sauce. For the prices they charge for the pasta dishes (~$23-26 per dish, which is so overpriced for pasta by the way) they should serve better food. The wine list is very limited, especially the number of wines they offer by the glass.

"Just like the white winged dove Sings a song Sounds like she's singing Who who who Just like the white winged dove Sings a song Sounds like she's singing Oh baby oh said oh"

A little background on me...Im a 39 year old laundry enthusiast that misses the crisp feel of analog pornography. Free videos are great but you cant hide them around a bedroom. Moving on.

So a few of my friends work close to the Capital Grille and we were celebrating a milestone birthday so we threw caution to the wind and said "Treat Yo Self". The whole point of going was to get Big Puma to pay for everything and that goon didnt even show up. Total bummer.

We spent most of the lunch discussing what we did to make Big Puma hate us. Was it the constant insults? Was it all the times i photoshopped his head into the great photos of the civil rights movement? All we know is once that dude started bathing in essential oils, hes changed.

The food was fine. Solid calamari. Steak sandwich was great. Even the salmon looked legit. Drinks were a little overpriced but the people that eat there can afford to over pay.

The atmosphere reminded me of place that wants you to know that they really enjoy the smell of their own farts. But who can blame em...The Kansas City Kid is a regular there.

After lunch its kind of a blur. I hit four more bars and tried to get drunk breakfast but Courtesy is still closed. It was the finest one year Stanley Cup celebration that ive ever had.

4 stars. I probably will never go back

In a TRUE BBQ wasteland, surrounded by nothing but national chains, stands this locally owned gem on its own. 

Curbside service (due to pandemic, for those finding review later) was spot on, very well executed, friendly and followed protocols. Now to the highlight - BBQ! Rib tips were great with plenty of meat and while some bones/cartilage is expected, most had been trimmed off perfectly. Pulled pork sandwich is usually not much to gloat about but came packed and full of smoky flavor. No skimping here. If I had to say anything bad, I felt their BBQ hot sauce to be odd tasting. Like a sauce finished with a flat domestic beer added in, after-taste and all. Sweet was just fine, so not much of an issue overall - just get it on the side imo. Try this place out and support local - you just might find a new favorite.

Awesome! The noodles at this place were great and the employees were really nice. The girl cashier helped me pick something vegetarian and gave me a discount since I wasn't getting meat. Thanks guys! Glad to hear business is popping

One of my favorite places to go, drinks are affordable, music is wicked, and the place has a great vibe. They also serve food until about 9m, which you can eat while watching some of the best jazz New Orleans has to offer!

My family has been going to Zemams for almost 14 years.   I went the first time for my 30th birthday, with my 6 month old on my lap. She is 14 and chose to go there for her 14th birthday! The food is amazing. We've tried most foods on the menu and everything is good. During quarantine we've ordered from them a few times, but order early, they sell out fast!
They hit new flooring.  The only thing I didn't like before was the flooring and the smell but it outstanding now.

I just had the best birthday night drinks/snacks at Ignite.  The staff was so attentive, that when someone went on break or left for the evening (we were there late and near closing) every time the current server and replacement server came to tell us who was who and who'd be taking care of us.  Such professional and unobtrusive service.  The food runner didn't leave the table until he asked if we had any questions.  Sharon was so welcoming and great.  Each staff member did their job to the fullest.  I wish I remembered the name of who took care of us after.  The avocado snacks were great (better than my home Ritz in Rancho Mirage, CA) beautiful charcuterie/cheese plate...just really a memorable birthday night.  Thanks, Ritz.

Huge  portions of everything they serve. Red gravy dishes are delicious and seafood cannelloni is also excellent. Steak night on Thursday is not their best thing. In fact I even went there on Thursday I would get there Italian food. That is what they do best. House salad is sometimes good but sometimes the caesar be a better choice

Average iced coffee and everything bagel with chive cream cheese. It was also a bit awkward to hear the manager yell at the staff for leaving the tea in a different spot... weird interaction to witness while in line.

The food at this and other Trident locations continue to be stellar (some item exceptions apply). That being said, this location has been a serious hit and miss with service. If you sit at the bar inside or outside, you are far less likely to have any problems. Table service is a weakpoint, as after receiving our drinks (and clearing up a minor miscommunication i wont blame the business for) we waited 20-30 minutes before having to ask if someone could take our order. I asked for the Sauted Cod Filet and was asked if i wanted the Tacos or the Sandwich. Apparently the waitress wasn't aware there was a Dinner entree item bearing the name verbatim.

The food me and my guest received were absolutely perfect. I wish i could rate this location higher but i may have to stick with the Craycroft location for its consistency in service.
Best place to eat in St Charles hands down! Service and food are always top notch, you won't be disappointed.

Service was excellent at moments and lacking at the same time with forgotten things and knowledge of items poor and man was it noisy which was almost unbearable. For the amount of money I spent I was expecting something to stand out. Of all the dishes only thing worth noting was the Brussels sprouts and the lamb. The rest was just ok. Drinks were good but expensive. Bisque was ok, lobster ravioli was good, bon femme was ok needed more bacon, tuna was cooked right but flavor was lacking, steak tartare was disappointing as was expecting foie gras on top but guess it was mixed it which means couldn't taste it still tasted decent. Macaroni he swore was the best and maybe he meant best at being the worst cause wow pasta was tough and cheese was not a good choice. Dessert was baked Alaska and that was delightful.  For the price everything should excel but this was just slightly better than mediocre.

In King of Prussia last week, my wife and I had dinner at Creeds. Everything about it was amazing, the food, the atmosphere and service. Living in South Florida we've had really great food and service but you guys nocked it out of the park. I'm a steak guy and my filet was perfection. My wife's Barramundi was "through the roof" thank you for a very enjoyable evening!

My husband and I have been twice! We absolutely love the Tostones!! So delicious and a great Gluten Free alternative! We also had the small cheese plate which was Plenty for two! I can only imagine the large! Had wine both times. Cute place. Love the music and vibe.

Delicious Cheesesteak! My friend recommended this place to me after saying that the cheesesteaks are amazing! I'm usually a plane Jane with things but the portion was just right the price was affordable ! And the food was hot and delicious. Highly recommend to anyone in a need of a nice meal!
Very Good Steaks and Very Friendly staff.  I had the Filet and Truffle Mac and Cheese, awesome. The steak was cooked to the correct temperature, and was quite flavorful.

So... this was my go-to for vegan food in Louisiana... The gumbo definitely needed more seasoning and the beignets were underwhelming (my friends said even DuMonde wasn't great). Not impressed, vegan or not... What stood out for me was the chocolate mousse, incredibly delicious, it has the normal dark chocolate after taste but, I loved it! I got take out so I can't say much about the staff but, those I did meet were awesome

Amazing cocktails, food and service!! Beautiful Mexican restaurant in downtown Tucson. My husband loved the lengua and tajas tacos and i loved the elote appetizer. Los churros were spectacular!! Definitely recommend this restaurant and their bourbon cocktail!!!

Tried this place because our other favorite was closed for memorial day. First time a d it didn't disappoint. Good, flavorful chicken. Breast wasn't dry but very good and had a nice spice. We couldnt done in but we promptly received out to go order.

I moved from Philly a few years ago and I still think about this restaurant all the time. Amazing amazing food and such good vibes. Meat is so tender and well seasoned, vegetable dishes are packed with flavor, everything goes well together.

Yum, yum, yum!  We had buffalo shrimp, crab cake sandwich and pan seared flounder sandwich to go on April 19 when we escape our town on a beautiful day during this pandemic. We came across this place in a strip mall and weren't sure what to expect. Food smelled great when we picked it up so we were super surprised and happy we took the chance.   The flounder sandwich was fresh, seasoned perfectly and the bistro sauce that came with it was so good we dipped the fries in it and my boyfriend put some in his crab sandwich. Next time we're near here, we will def stop in

Villa Peru is quaint, romantic and a tucked away restaurant located in the foothills. The restaurant itself is beautiful and I can't say enough good things about the food and service, quite literally everything is good. 

Their menu covers all the bases, their ceviche is light and delicious but when you're craving a good hearty meal; Villa Peru is also there to save the day. Their rotisserie chicken is superb. My personal favorite is the firjole conseco beef dish but I've tried a variety of items on the menu and I haven't had a single bad thing to say about anything. They have a good beer list and a wide variety of alcoholic beverages to meet anyone's needs.

For being located in an area that is heavily congested with high end chain restaurants, Villa Peru is a breath of fresh air. It is family owned and operated and the owners (Chuck and Frida) are kind and charismatic.  They put their heart and soul into this restaurant and I firmly believe that they have blessed Tucson with Peruvian delicacies.

For me, Potbelly's is all about nostalgia. As a Hoosier, I only was introduced to Potbelly's when visiting my cousins in Milwaukee: I had never been to a place that, by default, toasted sandwiches: Subway was our go-to, and, well, it was reserved for road trips only.

When I went to Potbelly's the first time, I discovered mushroom-forward sandwiches. First, it was the vegetarian sandwich: the standard. Always accompanied by an Oreo shake or smoothie (this was younger me, the version could afford the calories and the sugar). Then, I came across the mushroom melt: less bread that actually helped you TASTE the cheese better, as well as better overall veggie-to-bread ratios. A much more reasonable calorie count as well.

Potbelly's also carries some great, kettled-cooked potato chips that come in a variety of flavors like jalapeno. If you want a change from your usual sandwich joint, give Potbelly's a try. You won't regret it.

Been here a couple of times, first time with a group of people and second with two close girlfriends. Both experiences were very pleasant! The atmosphere is relaxing. First visit it was quite full but we got there early enough to get a good spot to sit. Even though it was packed, you don't feel cramped. You're not having to squeeze through people to move around. Maybe it can get like that on other nights but when we went, it was still a really good experience. Second time we got there right as they opened at around 4pm and enjoyed the patio while we drank some wine. 

This was the first place where I experienced a taste of canned wine. If you're a red drinker and trying their can, know that their indecent red blend is served chilled. I tried it and was not expecting it so it wasn't the best experience. Next round I asked to have it at room temperature and I enjoyed it so much more! I did try their indecent rose as well and that was delicious! On certain days, they have different happy hour specials. When we visited, it was 2 for 1 wine by the glass and I had the anonymous cabernet sauvignon and thoroughly enjoyed every sip. 

Food that I did have was their grilled cheese and french fries. It was absolutely delicious with their blend of white cheddar, pepper jack, and pimento cheese melted between perfectly crisped bread. French fries were on point as well! 

They do have a small parking lot but if you're drinking, might as well catch a Lyft or Uber anyway. I haven't had a cha

I love this First Watch. Service is fast. As long as you waitlist seating is also fast. Food is always so
Good and fresh. I wish they had outside seating though. Ive started going to the new location in Lutz because they have outside seating. But they dont have their act together yet. So I will be back at Bruce B Downs until they work out their kinks.

Excellent food! Excellent service. The best sushi!!!! I had never been here and this gem will be visited a lot more! Excellent!!!
Eskimo Roll
Rainbow Roll
Caterpillar roll
Crazy roll
Octopus sushi
Unagi
Salmon sushi
Tuna sushi
 And they brought my mom a piece of strawberry cheesecake for her birthday!
Thank you to the owner (Jeff) for showing you care about your business and customers!

They are close to my home and I was going most days for breakfast. I love the staff, ambiance and the menu. I miss it a lot with COVID19 situation. I still get take out. I hope things will get better so I can go back and have a sit down meal. Support our local business.

Amazing with Mexican cuisine! The food at El Trompo will leave you stuffed and satisfied -that's what she said! Oh all jokes aside the food at El Trompo really does have flavor and soul. Most recently they added birria & quesibirria tacos on the weekends (Saturday and Sunday only). The tacos IMHO are priced but worth every penny. The ingredients are always fresh and the quality never lacks. 
The service is always great, my family has been coming here since 2018 and its been great to see them go from a small minimal seating hole in a wall to the expanded seating area and bar Hendersonville staple they are today. The service is consistent and the menu is larger but the quality doesn't change.

Hands down the WORST service ever. Not just once but twice. Just tried having dinner there tonight and we will never return again. Just put it this way the waitress so so horrible even her manager told me that he has gotten a few complaints about her and already had planned on having a talk with her. The only reason for the 1 star was due to the manager comping my entire meal.

I went there last night with my family for my cousin's 35th birthday. It's BYOB and every one is so friendly. The food was delicious, flavorful, and the owner was super friendly as well. The staff and owner checked on us a multitude of times. The service was a 10 out of 10...it was a great experience and we can't wait to go again. If you want a great time, you got to try this place !!!! Words cannot describe how incredible it was.
The food still good, but took out a few items including my favorite Mackerel.  If i need that dish, guess will need to back to the original owner's new place in Clearwater.

My family and I were on our way back home and decided to stop for some breakfast and this location did not disappoint one bit. First off, all the employees were really friendly which made our breakfast pleasant! Their menu all sounds and is delicious! They have lots of variety which made it hard to decide, but I ended up getting the the #1 breakfast sandwich with a Jalapeño cheddar bagel. Our sandwiches were freshly made, warm and everything and more you could want in a bagel. This place absolutely exceeded my expectations and it was very easy to find with lots of parking. This was the BEST bagel I've ever had! I will for sure come back to try out more bagels!

The best food we have had on bourbon street!! And sooooo affordable! Highly recommend a burger. My husband and I can hardly finish our food, and it's all under $25 for a meal for two!!! Best hidden gem!!!

We love the cafe for breakfast and when on the island, it is our go-to restaurant for breakfast.  We tried dinner and it was also an excellent choice. We were able to be seated quickly (we ate indoors). Drinks were ordered (pricey btw: $16 for a 9 oz glass of so so red, about the same for a margarita). The meals were more reasonable - I had blackened seafood, my husband had filet mignon and our son had ribs.  We were all very satisfied. We shared key lime pie and chocolate cake for dessert.  The cake was da bomb. Our wait person Chels, was efficient, knowledgeable and sassy.  We liked her a lot :)
I stopped in out of curiosity.  Glad I did!!!  The ribs are incredible!!!  The staff is friendly and very hard working!!  Excellent food.  Stop passing by and stop in!

Friendly tidy local coffee shop in Mid City, as is our custom we arrived on bicycles.
Liked the designated racks and even had an AIR PUMP !
Indoor / outdoor seating is spacious.
Lovely helpful staff.
FRESH decaffinated coffee for us.
Almond milk HEATED was appreciated.
Snacks: Lentil salad and delicious vinaigrette was REALLY good.
Less so, the slightly dry savory scone could have used a chutney or ?
Clean tidy place, WiFi good, lotsa locals hard at their 'work'.
Would return and recommend if y'all find yerself Mid City, drop in to the STATION @ 4400 Bienville
One of my favorite little mom & pop diners. Excellent food, great portions, great prices , & the service is great! I recommend the Greek salad and gyro. It's fantastic, & very filling!

The food is always pretty good, and I especially like the bread that they give you. Today, my chicken maidera was awesome.  My waitress was also really nice, but It did take her quite a long time to take our orders, bring our drinks out, bring bread out, bring the check, etc. I feel like they need more waitstaff there because there always seems to be hold ups. Other than that, the food and ambiance is good.

This place is delicious! The pastries are to die for. I got the huevos rancheros breakfast burrito - it was filling and so tasty. Adding avocado to it was a good idea. The inside is small but really cute. Great place for a quick bite.

They have some great baked goods - the Snowflake White and apple fritter are highlights - but the service is consistently bad. There is zero sense of urgency to get anything out of the kitchen. I've called ahead for a toasted bagel and still had to wait 15 minutes in the store to receive it. Another time I ordered a dozen bagels but told they are not a bagel shop and was asked why I needed so many. They ended up selling them to me, but only after admonishing me that doing so meant fewer bagels for other customers. 

What???

They could be a great bakery if they only they would address the service issues.

It is simple. The absolute best hamburger and french fries I have ever had in my life. I could not finish it and was going to save half for my teenage son but I did not. I ate it all, took me three hours total. Savory seasoned just right and a grilled flavor to the meat and burnt perfectly as I had requested. Plenty of fries for two people, actually the whole meal was enough for two people easily. The waiter was a fast moving son of a gun. He was on it, I needed a to-go box as he read my mind. He appeared to be tending to about 10 tables on his own and he did with a happy disposition. 
It was a bit loud but maybe that is just the acoustics of an old building, but I'd push through that for the food.
The service was absolutely impeccable. Food delicious!  Fried green tomato, oysters, red fish!!!!

Do you ever drop in a restaurant or bar and immediately feel like every single customer in that place knows each other?  And genuinely enjoys each other's company.  Stop into Coop's next time you find yourself down past the French Market on Decatur St and I betcha you will here.  

Very casual, very friendly crowd in an almost full bar on a rainy Sun afternoon. Good tunes. Lively banter and inclusive conversations. Wonderful smells of fresh Cajun-cooked specialities. Cold beer. Professional waitstaff + plenty of attentive bartenders. 

We decided to graze on the appetizer side of the menu while we sucked down a few cold Abita's. Good call. Wonderful fried catfish. Tasty fried oysters. Delicious fried shrimp. Savory gumbo. Everything we sampled was just yummy.  

We had to pry ourselves away so we could go meet our friends and follow-up our beers with a few classic cocktails while we take another couple of spins around the Carousel Bar. 

We've found another fabulous food-n-drink dive bar in Nola.  Very fun place. Lucky us.

Authentic Thai food in the grove! Got the Pad Thai lunch special and it was pretty good along with the portions. Will have to try something else here if you have any recommendations let me know @hybrideater

I went to N7 for the first time last night and absolutely loved it. The ambiance is just right. Great lighting. Great layout. Could work for a group thing and also a date thing. 

The food itself is also fantastic. We ordered a good mix of menu staples and specials, some of our first choice items were sold out (was really looking forward to the pavlova), even though we didn't always get our first choice, everything we did end up ordering was fantastic, we probably would not have ended up trying and really enjoying some of the things we ordered, if we had gotten our go-tos. 

Moral of the story, you can't go wrong here. Somehow, even the annoying train noises add to the charm. Will be back and would recommend!

This review is based on togo orders. The service for dine in is fine, if they mess up on something it is okay, you are there and they can fix it right away. I'm beyond frustrated because we eat here either dine in or togo at least 2 to 4 times a week. BUT every time we place an order for togo, something is ALWAYS missing and its so annoying because we'll be at home ready to eat and it's missing the most important ingredient like the fish sauce or extra items that we get on the sides. We do not check in the car if items are missing because we're always in a rush but instead we ask them if everything in our order is there. At this point we just gotta try to find another Vietnamese restaurant for our togo orders, it just gets ridiculous at this point! Also, to add in, each person tells you different things when you order. Either you can't substitute an item or you can and others charge you for it, not very consistent here. I wouldn't do togos, just to save your frustration, eat in or go elsewhere.

Had to have some beignets with coffee! They were great as a snack! I personally loved dipping them into my coffee.  

Coffee was a bit stronger than I expected.

Staff was really nice and food came out fast. 

A must for anybody wanting a tasty snack! 
No wait time either

If you want the flavor of homemade cooking, try Toscana.  The fall menu is terrific and the lentil soup tasted like my grandmothers. We are picking more up tonight to take to a friends house. From Bronzino to pizza, every meal I've had there is excellent. It has become our GO TO place for lunch or dinner.

intimate setting, good food, but had a couple of inconsistent dishes.

Came here with a private dining group and tasting menu dishes not normally on the menu.  I enjoyed what I had but there were a few miscalculations in my opinion.

Our first course was the tabbuleh salad which I enjoyed however I thought the pretzel plate was a little too plain.  I loved their roast veggies and hummus which should not be surprising as this is a middle eastern inspired restaurant.  The pasta course was very good however I thought the fish kababs lacked salt.  And finally I thought the lamb sausage with collard greens was too salty or at least the collard greens were.  And the presentation was not too appetizing, brown sausage on top of brown over cooked salty collards, maybe some blanched kale with some color and crunch would have elevated the dish.  Dessert was good but not mind blowing.  

I'd definitely give this one another go and try again but need to look a the menu which does change seasonally first.
This was a great time! Cool views on the Mississippi River while eating dinner and listening to jazz music. Must do in New Orleans!

I've been to this place a few times, the food has always been great, avacodo toast is definitely my go to.  The patio is perfect on a nice day and love that they use fresh local ingredients.  The staff is not overly friendly though.  Granted I've had a few that were awesome but the last few times I've had a hostess that seemed irritated and a waiter that seemed overwhelmed and felt rushed.  It's a busy place so I know it can be tough.  I still recommend and will be back
Just do it!! Great food, great service and great people! Had the breaded tenderloin and a Bourbon barrel ale. Full, happy and will stop by as often as possible.
Great lunch spot! Excellent live music! We enjoyed the outdoor seating. Alligator po'boy and half a muffuletta did not disappoint. Refreshing iced tea  Service was very good.
Im super picky about hot sauce, this place has the best, I recommend getting the red salsa made to perfection!

One of my all time favorite date night spots in Reno. Fantastic service, beautiful patio and the food is always amazing.
We called ahead a couple hours in advance to make a reservation but there were still a few tables available for a party of two when we arrived at 6:30 on a Friday. Tables are distanced and servers are wearing masks.
Our servers have always been attentive, getting drinks out right away and the food always comes out fast too. Our server this time was Jennifer and we couldn't have asked for more.
If you're wondering what to order, the Kobe sliders and meatballs with polenta are my favorites!
Can't wait for our next visit!

You are warmly and sincerely greeted at the door. They are very kind. They clearly have no issues working together and helping one another. The food was amazing. Very fresh and perpared perfectly. The spices had flavour and heat. Everything was deliciouse. I was very happy as was my spouse. I'm only sorry we have not gone in before hand. The chicken was not overcooked as most places are. This is one of the very few Indian establishments I've enjoyed. Worth every penny.

This place is a sweet gem on State street. My partner and I stop by and picked a boxes of goodies for later. We got a lemon bar, raspberry cookie, cheesecake bite, and eclair. Each one was delicious in it's own way. The cream in the eclair was a light sweet cream. Next time I'm am getting two. The cheesecake bite was perfect! I will visit again for some new treats.

They tried.

They tried to make a mushroom trio. It lacked salt and flavor and any semblance of presentation. A plate of brown mush.

They tried to make gnocchi, but half of the dumplings were undercooked and dry on the inside. Not fresh. Not even frozen. Definitely not good. Dry. Sad. Underwhelming. Like a Trump presidency.

Unfortunately, the other 5 people with me shared similar sentiments about their meals. Fortunately, we brought wine. Thank god for BYOB.

And they only take cash. In the time of the Rona. When everyone else has embraced digital transactions. Only. Cash. C'mon. Get it together.

Oh, and they charge tip *on top* of the tax, not on the pre-tax amount. I was gonna give them 2 stars until I saw that. This place sucks. Go to Melograno on 20th and Sansom instead.

I'll spare you photos. You can find plenty of disappointment in the other photos that users have shared.
Good food and service. I had biscuits and gravy, I liked the biscuits the best. My husband had the catfish, he thought it was good. Our server was very friendly and attentive.

This is one of my husband's favorite places to get burgers. I always stock up when I come here. The price is a little bit high but you pay for what you get sometimes and so it is definitely worth the cost. Always clean, friendly staff, and according to my husband the best burgers ever.

Waitress was nice. The tables were a little too close for my liking... Literally elbow to elbow. Food was amazing! Band was about 20 mins late to play they apologized but still if I am paying $5 for a live jazz band I expect them to be in time. Atmosphere was nice and cozy. Definitely will visit again and try the karaoke section next

Amazing foodie place, come here, order from the full bar, leave satisfied.
Everything was amazing,  pretzels are normally boring, but it was a strong first go, finished up with an amazing decadent burger and then a great (but maybe too mild) hot chicken sandwich
One of my favorite spots in fountain square! Great beer and food. My only issue is with the nachos: please put on a larger plate with more salsa. Otherwise, 10/10 recommend this place!

This hole in the wall... is Everything!
It's actually quite charming. 
The staff was all very welcoming.
The FOOD... omg.
So, they offer Mimosa's and Bloody Mary's, but do not advertise it. 
I had to read reviews from YELP and I'm so GLAD I did. 
This Bloody Mary with its spice and Bacon and Olives was just the hair of the dog I needed plus it was very tasty.
In addition, I had the classic Eggs Benedict with home fries! The Hollandaise was the perfect buttery, creamy deliciousness!! The eggs packed to perfection!!
By the time I realized, I needed to write a review... I was nearly half way through my meal... Excellent!!

VERY large pizza, but size is not everything especially if it doesn't taste good.  I gave 4 stars because I did really like the margarita with mushroom, but the cheese pizza with extra cheese tasted like it had a very strong aftertaste to it cant think of what it was but it was a very strong cheese.

This is by far the best pizza joint in Santa Barbara besides Patxi's deep dish. I love how they pack on the toppings unlike other pizza chains. Their pizza crust is so crunchy and stays fairly crunchy the next day which is a plus.

Aside from pepperoni pizza, their white chicken pizza is one of my favorite. The white sauce is definitely not your typical white sauce, it's more on the garlicky side so it cuts a lot of the richness normally white sauces are known for. Because it wasn't super rich and heavy my wife (normally doesn't like white or cream base pizza or pastas) liked it. 

We've been here three times and the amount of toppings, the flavor and the crunch of the dough has always been consistent. Oh, can't forget about their ranch, it's made in house and is one of the best ranches I've had in a long while.

I'm not a big pizza fan nor do I crave pizza often but ever since I've had their pizza, I crave it once in awhile. Especially when I want some crunchy savory carbs.
Dalessandro's In the Roxborough section of Philadelphia is one of the best places to get a cheesesteak in the city. Always worth the wait.

Lived in Louisiana most of my life, been to many many fine restaurants and - for whatever reason - never made it to "Brennan's for Breakfast" - even though I've heard about it all my life from many many people. 

Today was the day I addressed the Brennan's Drought. And - Wow! - what a way to do it. We were well taken care of by Roy who was knowledgeable, charming, witty and had the right amount of New Orleans sass that I've come to expect here. He was awesome. 

The meal started with cocktails and warm Leidenheimer Bread (Anyone over 45 remembers their commercials) - app was Oysters J'aime - delicious. That was followed by Eggs St Charles - divine; Thick Sliced Bacon and Bananas Foster made right here in the BIRTHPLACE of this famous dessert. The show was as good as the dessert - simple but elegant - and perfectly prepared. Delightful atmosphere topped it all off. Sorry I waited so long but - even so - it totally lived up to and exceeded its considerable reputation.

Not worth the hype. I was honestly SO EXCITED to visit Cafe Du Monde and try the famous Beignets. But... it's not the best honestly. Unless you're a big funnel cake person then you'll love them. However for me.. not worth waiting in these long lines. I got lucky and visited the location right outside the NOMA where the line was not as long. However, the Cafe Au Lait was delicious. Coffee-4. Beignets-2 out of 5.
We've had their menu for awhile, and I think we've ordered from there before. Now we tried and they say they don't deliver here anymore (2nd & Wash)...

Table of three, 45 min wait time and an almost empty restaurant.
I've had better food at a denny's, and certainly for about half the price with better service. If my food isn't coming to me hot then i'm not coming back.

If you're sane, stay away from this place, there's much better options.

Nice place, I dined in the court yard which was very nice and quite! For a started I order the fried green tomatoes which were very tasty, not a lot of crab meat! But they are a must try. The chicken and sausage gumbo wasn't my favorite. It was loaded down with sausage! The NOLA house salad with shrimp was really good and fresh! Maybe say light jalapeño because boy! It was filled with them. Great place to dine overall !
Some of the best pizza I've ever had, Bone collector being my favorite. Also a fantastic beer selection that is constantly changing!
Good service and food was good. Dan Dan noodles was a little to peanut butter forward good for those who loves peanut butter

Great! For forever have been going to Lotus Inn but prices kept escalating and quality was trending down, so went on a search for new Chinese take-out in the Berwyn-Paoli area and found Cheng Du.

I'm caucasian and not an expert on authenticity, but I walked into the restaurant and every table was occupied by Chinese families -- I can't tell you the last time I actually saw a Chinese person eating in a Chinese restaurant.  Their menu runs from Kung Pao (which we got) to the exotic -- lots of things with frogs! I can't say it was authentic, because I wouldn't know, but it was AWESOME!!!  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.  Next trip want to venture to something a bit less mainstream than Kung Pao.

Now if we could only find a similarly authentic Mexican restaurant!!!!!
Can't wait for them to reopen. This is one of my favorite places to grab a cocktail and a vegan meal. Super cute atmosphere and the staff is always great!
Excellent clean food.  Especially great on Saturday and Sunday's for brunch when they have egg bowls.

Why is this place so popular? I got the summer roll amd bourbon chicken. Chicken was tough and bland. The summer roll was just a lot of noodles, lettuce, 1 or 2 mint or basil and 3 pieces of half shrimp. A typical summer roll is supposed to have pork but this one didn't. Also the peanut sauce was way too sweet. I was really hungry but couldn't finish 1 summer roll (it came in a pair) and only ate 3 spoonfuls of the rice and bourbon chicken. Disappointed.
Always visit here when I arrive to NOLA...BBQ Shrimp are absolutely hands down my favorite & super delicious and worth the price!!

Atmosphere-5 stars. Food-ok. Value-poor.  Appetizers:  Tuscan Tower-this was delicious. Calamari was pretty much the same as anywhere although somewhat small portion wise. My son got the brasciole and was happy. My husband and one daughter got the seafood cannelloni. Disappointing. My husband said he was sure it had imitation crabmeat. Not worth the money. Another daughter got seafood caravelle. It was just okay. Lots of mussels, but mussels are cheap so for the price not worth it. I got veal with crab and asparagus. It was quite bland. I was asked for spinach instead of potatoes and was charged $4. I could have kept the potatoes and ordered a whole plate of spinach for $4. Bad customer relations for people who don't eat carbs. Last daughter got rigatoni in vodka sauce. Again, just ok. When we got the bill we were also charged extra for Caesar salads. The waiter asked if we wanted house or Caesar, which implies a choice, not an upcharge. Also, $4 extra for French onion soup but on the menu it is only $1 more. Dessert:  tiramisu- definitely have had better, if you like tiramisu don't get it. Lemon cello cake was good but was only a sliver so not worth the $7. The website is out of date. The menus are different and the website tells you to get a coupon on yelp which the waiter said is not valid during the pandemic. All in all we felt nickel and dimed for subpar food. Atmosphere was great but not worth the $400 we dropped. I would recommend going for a drink and an appetizer but

Great atmosphere and wait staff. We've been here several times and have sampled most items on the menu. A couple of favorites are the French Onion soup, the Shellfish Stew, as well as their burgers. They used to have a delicious Vietnamese sandwich. I hope it returns.

Delicious pizza served fast! The crust was perfect and the toppings were generous. The sauce tasted homemade. It's been a while since I've had a pie this good.

Customer service was excellent. Dillon was helpful and courteous. 

The establishment is dated inside but do not judge a book by its cover.

I am from Madison Wisconsin and was in Boise for personal reasons. I love Greek/Mediterranean food and decided to stop here for lunch. I picked this place based on yelp ratings.  I had a dish that included a lot of vegetarian options. Though I can't remember what the dish was called I know it included babaghanoush and falafel, along with an eggplant salad.  I was very happy with my choice and everything was delicious.  I have to admit, the babaghanoush was The best I have had. I purchased a piece of baklava to go (I was told this is made in house) and had it later that evening.  That too was Great.  Though the restaurant was not in the greatest location and the decor was not the greatest, the food was awesome. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys Mediterranean food.
Excellent food, excellent service! Can't say enough good things. Trying the chicken tenders! You will not be disappointed!

One of the beast seafood platters on this side of the river.   It's such a massive amount of food and everything was cooked to perfection and lightly battered. The thin catfish is a win. The crawfish queso was to die for as well!!! Let's get back to that platter though.. those seasoned wedges have a garlic butter sauces on them that's so robust and flavor packed. It went perfect on the wedges and moistened up crispy fries nicely. The crab cakes are okay. Not my favorite but that's bc I prefer fresh lump crab meat and any style but fried. I personally feel it takes the flavor away and authenticity of a natural meat being used. The platter is by far one of the ones to come back just to eat

Great atmosphere and really good food. We have been there several times for celebrations. They make their desserts in house and they are super delicious. The food is quite different and more European style, so is the interior of this place

Very clean place with a harmonious service. Their traditional dishes are phenomenal, their portions along with the rich flavors are very distinct in restaurant . I highly recommend the Butter chicken and Tikka masala with some garlic naan.

This spot was a nice reprieve from the rain and typical Southern fare. Everything we had was put together exactly as we expected. Food was good and aligned with our expectations. The service was solid even though it was busy. Our cups were rarely left empty. The gyoza are my favorite and were certainly tasty here. Prices are reasonable considering the food options.

Best dairy free & vegan ice cream in town! I've searched for a good vegan ice cream for a while, all resulting in altered taste and not quality ice cream I was looking for. Cashew Cow's ice cream is creamy and perfectly sweet, you can't tell it's dairy free! The staff was super friendly, as well as the owner, she creates everything by scratch in her store! super cute! love love love!

The food is amazing & authentic, but the service is below average. I called in for a to go order 50 min in advance. I've done this many times prior. When I got there, I still had to wait while they completed cooking. I didn't think chicken wings took that much time. When I inquired about the delay in preparation, they're response was "Many people were in front of your order." Really? For almost an hour? This was not specified over the phone. Wtf?!

We've enjoyed Amani's quite a few times and last night was no exception Everything is at a high level, with great attention to details like providing very nice bread rolls, along with an olive oil dip and an inventive amuse bouche. I haven't been disappointed in any entree, but last night I had a sous vide chicken breast that was amazing.  I sampled my brother-in-law's ramen with pork belly, which was also just right.

The BYOB aspect of Amani's is not to be ignored. You can pair your meal with excellent wines, at retail store prices, with no corkage fee. That alone makes Amani one of the best bargains in our area for fine dining. My wife and I shared a Willamette Valley Pinot Noir that would have cost at least $60 in another restaurant.

Unfortunately, our dinner was marred by a loud, cackling woman at the next table. She was so loud I think it was heard by passing truck drivers. This wasn't Amani's fault, so I have not dinged them in this review, but damn, woman, have some courtesy toward your fellow humans.
This was more like korean fusion to me. Food was okay, a little americanized. Prize was average for Korean. Service was ass.

One of the best local coffee shops in St. Charles. Two locations- main st and 5th st. 

The also have live music at night and sell alcohol!

Great food, friendly staff, a favorite for my husband and I. Never had any complaints about the food, always fresh, always cooked perfectly. My husband always orders steak and it is always cooked exactly how he likes it. I highly recommend the Aussie cheese fries as an appetizer, it's incredible and a must get for us. The only downside to this location is that it is one of the smaller Outback locations so it can take a little bit to get a table during dinner, especially on the weekend, but they definitely make it worth the wait. We have also ordered for pickup and delivery from this location both with great service and no complaints!

Went here on a Sunday late morning, before a Indianapolis Indians game. Two reasons:
1: They have BRUNCH!
2. They are VERY kid friendly!

I just can't wrap my head around every "yelper" that marks places as "not good for kids"...and I said that in a very mocking way whilst shaking my finger....sheesh. If "yelper elites" are classifying places kid friendly as Chuck E Cheeses, then they're ultimately doing a big disservice to establishments that are fantastic, and deserve more business.

i.e. This place!

Fantastic, friendly service, AND management. Not overly annoying, just a good check in on how things were for us, and if everything was to out liking. Couldn't have been more pleased!

We had a cheeseburger, which if you think, meh, why go with a boring old cheeseburger, you won't be disappointed! Fantastic! 

Also went with the breakfast nachos. If I could, I would eat these every morning. They were awesome!

Bloodies, and mimosas were spot on as well.

We will be back!
Great food and good prices. I really like the Chicken Tikka Masala and Chicken Korma here. The service was good too. I will definitely go again.

Do NOT go here! Zero stars. I ordered 4 large pizzas for work. I called an hour after it was supposed to be delivered. I was told the order was cancelled because they didn't have any delivery drivers. They did not notify us or apologize. Was extremely rude that I even called to ask about the order.

My experiences are always great when I come in to this Hooters location. The only improvement I can think of would be to make Cymantha a bar tender. She is always great and I would probably come in more if she was behind the bar.

I hesitated on going to Sweetea at the beginning. They didn't seem to have as much options of boba as other boba places. Then I tried it and I wish I went sooner. The teas are very fragrant and delicious, which made the boba teas even better!  The staff there are extremely nice and courteous. I haven't ordered food from there, so this review is strictly based on their drinks.
Nice little coffee shop, pretty good coffee to boot.  It's a short walk from the hotel in Penn's landing.

Great food. Sad to see the fish and chips go. Hopefully they bring back the remaining portions of the menu. Those fish and chips were amazing. The ceasar salad was also crisp and fresh. I didn't visit the wine club, because that's not my forte. Woukd love to try something else off their menu.

We order from here almost weekly. We've tried everything from the pizza to the Stromboli to the Subs and Sausage Stromboli. Everything is excellent! If you want delivery, think ahead. It often takes at least an hour but they're good at giving you a delivery time and sticking by it. Best pizza in St. Petersburg in my opinion. Thin crust, NY style. Excellent! If you're missing East Coast style pizza, or just want to try it, this is the place to go. Cash only $$$
Great food and great service! The menu has so many great options and I loved my po boy sandwich! I will definitely be returning!
